snippets.name: Signature
snippets.text:
Jane Doe - jane.doe@example.com
Head of Widgets
Acme Ltd

snippets.name: Styled snippet
snippets.text:
Snippets can contain bold, underline and colors.
	1. lists like this one
	2. links like example.com
snippets.html:
Snippets can contain bold, underline and colors.

  1. lists like this one
  2. links like example.com

snippets.name: Dates
snippets.text: Today is {time: MMMM D, YYYY}. In 2 weeks it will be {time: MMMM D, YYYY; shift=2W}.
snippets.html: Today is {time: MMMM D, YYYY}. In 2 weeks it will be {time: MMMM D, YYYY; shift=2W}.

snippets.name: Form
snippets.text:
Hi {formtext: name=your name},

A customer bought {formtext: name=quantity; default=25} widgets at ${formmenu: name=price; 12.00; default=24.00; 48.00} each, totalling ${=price * quantity}.
snippets.html:
Hi {formtext: name=your name},

A customer bought {formtext: name=quantity; default=25} widgets.

snippets.name: Pure form
snippets.text:
Hi {formtext: name=recipient},

Your order of {formtext: name=quantity; default=25} widgets at {formmenu: name=price; 12.00; default=24.00; 48.00} is confirmed.

Notes: {formparagraph: name=notes}

Thanks {formtext: name=recipient}!

snippets.name: Plain with braces
snippets.text: Literal {curly} braces that are not commands stay as text
snippets.html: Literal {curly} braces that are not commands stay as text
